description: Model Design and Building teaches how models communicate ideas: shop and 3D-printing safety, the kinds of models professionals use, planning an original model to scale, building one model, and designing a fantasy spacecraft.

safety.note: Use hand tools, glues, resins and 3D printers with protective gear and adult supervision.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Safety
requirements.summary: Safe use of hand tools, protective gear, and 3D printing and resin precautions.

requirements.title: Models and materials
requirements.summary: Architectural, structural, process, mechanical and industrial models, and design and fabrication tools.

requirements.title: Planning a model
requirements.summary: Choosing a subject and preparing scaled plans and lists of materials and tools for an original design.

requirements.title: Building a model
requirements.summary: One option: an architectural, structural, process, mechanical or industrial model.

requirements.title: A fantasy model
requirements.summary: Researching, designing and rendering a special-effects spacecraft.
